text: I think you'll really enjoy this Thai Chicken With Basil and Coconut Milk recipe. As someone who likes chicken and is looking for higher protein options, this dish fits the bill with 26 grams of protein per serving. It's also gluten-free, which aligns with your dietary constraints. The cooking time is quick, too, coming in under 30 minutes, so it fits within your time budget. The combination of flavors from the coconut milk, basil, and chilies will likely appeal to you, and it's a relatively balanced meal in terms of macronutrients.
